title: After-contact summarization pipeline with knowledge retrieval and a faithfulness eval
scenario: Larkspur agents spend 90 seconds per contact typing ServiceNow work notes. Build the EventBridge-triggered pipeline that summarizes the redacted transcript with Bedrock Converse (forced tool call, guardrail), redacts again, retrieves related KB articles, writes the incident work note and contact attributes idempotently, and gate it with a deterministic faithfulness eval. Recorded fixtures only.
task: Deterministic PII redaction before and after the model (Luhn-checked cards, SSN, email, phone, password)
Converse request with a forced record_acw_summary tool, guardrail and untrusted-data system prompt
Knowledge base Retrieve with an audience filter, score threshold and citations
Idempotent handler: claim, retry semantics, ServiceNow work note, UpdateContactAttributes
Faithfulness, hallucination and coverage eval over five recorded cases
acceptance: No PII reaches Bedrock or ServiceNow; guardrail and invalid outputs never reach ServiceNow
EventBridge redelivery causes no second model call or work note
Eval verdicts match the expected results
